text: The Patriots made notable roster moves this week, releasing linebacker Jose Ramirez while adding cornerback Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad and parting with offensive lineman Da'Metrius Weatherspoon, but the real story was their 29-26 upset victory over the Buffalo Bills in Week 4 that pulled them back to 2-2 after staring at a 1-3 record. Drake Maye bounced back from his early-season struggles with a clutch performance in that comeback win, which head coach Mike Vrabel described as critical for the defending AFC champions in a season where the Patriots, Rams, and Cowboys all salvaged their campaigns with stunning rallies. Looking ahead to Week 5 against the Las Vegas Raiders, the Patriots will need to prepare for a formidable tight end duo in Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer after neutralizing Dalton Kincaid in the Bills game—and they'll do so while honoring Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri during a halftime ceremony on October 11. Meanwhile, the organization recognized Central Catholic High School head coach John Dubzinski as the Patriots Coach of the Week after his team's 52-51 upset victory.
